text.p: MedPartners said today that it bought two physician run health care practices.
The physician practice managment group said it bought the Suburban Heights Medical Group, based in Chicago and Cardinal IPA, based in Raleigh, North Carolina.
Terms and conditions of both deals were not disclosed, a MedPartners spokesman said.
Suburban Heights Medical Center joined MedPartners on June 30, 1997, the company said in a statement.

Suburban Heights is one of Chicago's largest multi- specialty physician practices, with 56 physicians, serving more than 120,000 patients through its locations in Chicago Heights and Frankfort. Suburban Heights is MedPartners' entry into the south Chicago suburbs.
Cardinal IPA, a physician run practice was founded in August of 1995 and has 323 doctors.
